answer: Require each agent to maintain a public atlas of its economic relationships: counterparties, stakes, and timestamps. Like an island nation granting entry only after many locals vouch for a newcomer, a sybil attacker finds one fake identity cheap but a full web of vouching expensive. Weight votes by the age and depth of this attestation graph, so the sweet nectar of peer endorsements accrues only over time and a fresh cluster of sock puppets carries near-zero weight.
